entities.summary: Masanori Takahashi, professionally known as Kitarō (喜多郎), is a Japanese musician, composer, record producer, and arranger noted for his electronic-instrumental music, and is often associated with and regarded as one of the most prominent musical acts of new-age music. He won the Grammy Award for Best New Age Album for Thinking of You (1999), with a record 16 nominations in the same category. He received a Golden Globe Award for the original score to Heaven & Earth (1993). Kitarō was a composers & musicians from Toyohashi (b. 1953-02-04, Toyohashi). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
